name: Suzhou Kingswood Education Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Kingswood Education Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the ink chemical and teaching businesses in China and internationally. It operates through the Education and Training Division and the Ink Chemicals Division segments. The company offers sheet-fed offset, coldset and heatset web offset, thermosetting rotary offset, and UV curing inks products, as well as Spot colors, Gold and Silver inks, and high-concentrated flushes and additives, and other printing materials. It also provides secondary vocational schools, full-time schools and vocational skills training services. In addition, the company exports its products to various countries.
